moments.author: Adam Schefter
moments.quote: In a post on X, Shefter says Ditka's family announced the news (that Ditka had died at 86).
moments.why: This post broke the legendary Mike Ditka’s death, sparking massive reaction across NFL communities.
moments.url: CBS coverage quoting his X post

moments.author: Chicago Bears
moments.quote: Player. Coach. Legend. Mike Ditka embodied the spirit of Chicago and will be deeply missed.
moments.why: Official team tribute resonated widely among fans and amplified the viral wave of condolences.

moments.author: Ozzie Guillen
moments.quote: Coach, man, we had some great times, laughs, and memories over the years… Chicago lost a legend Rest easy, Coach.
moments.why: Former player’s personal tribute added emotional depth that fans latched onto.
moments.url: AOL article quoting his X post

moments.author: Mike Mixon
moments.why: Joe Mixon’s celebratory return post after joining the Seahawks went viral among NFL fans.
moments.url: Heavy.com article quoting his X post
